Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrite positivity, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Mild proteinuria and hematuria are present. Low urine specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of antibiotic therapy.
